identity.description: An attacker uses a service account to perform repeated NTLM authentication attempts against a target system, triggering a brute force detection. Cortex should detect repeated authentication failures and process behavior related to credential harvesting.

expected_artifacts.description: Connection to target IP over SMB port 445

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: NTLM Brute Force on Service Account
biocs.description: Multiple failed NTLM authentication attempts using a service account
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter action_process_image_name = 'net.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| comp count() as cnt by by actor_process_image_name

abiocs.name: NTLM Brute Force Pattern
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation indicating repeated failed authentication attempts using service account
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter action_process_image_name = 'net.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| comp count() as cnt by by actor_process_image_name
| filter count > 3
abiocs.causality_anchor: cmd.exe executing net.exe to connect to target IP
